note: Starter screen readiness when the launch predictor (ReferenceAscent, the live pad's checks and director) says the flight fails, the landing fuel is short, or the cargo does not fit (DESIGNER_TIERS_SPEC 'Honest Ready', audit B-10). Cause ids match StarterVerdict.Causes. kid is the plain lead sentence the Starter shows; engineer is the same cause in engineering terms (Builder/Engineer tiers). fixes are Starter controls, most helpful first; the screen names the first two that can still move, else reset. Fix order was picked from a sweep of every Starter setting on every mission.

maxq.kid: It would shake apart in the thick air.
maxq.engineer: Max-Q break-up: dynamic pressure passes the structure's q limit low in the climb.

overload.kid: It would buckle under its own weight.
overload.engineer: Structural margin below zero: the stack load passes what the tanks can carry.

overg.engineer: Over-g: peak sensed acceleration passes the payload or stack g limit near burnout.

tumble.kid: It would flip over in the air.
tumble.engineer: Tumble: angle of attack or stability left the controllable range in dense air.

heat.kid: Its nose would get too hot.
heat.engineer: Thermal: nose temperature passes the material limit.

base-heat.kid: So many engines would cook its base.
base-heat.engineer: Base heating: more than nine engines with no heat shield, past 5 kPa.

cryo.kid: The cold fuel would crack its tanks.
cryo.engineer: Cryo-on-composite: a cryogenic propellant in a tank material with cryoOK false fails at T+0.

separation.kid: Its stages would bump when they split.
separation.engineer: Separation collision: stage relative speed below the minimum in the separation window.

legs.engineer: Leg collapse: touchdown sink rate passes the legs' rating.

overpressure.kid: An engine would push too hard and break.
overpressure.engineer: Engine overpressure: chamber pressure passes 1.15 × rated.

pad.kid: It would break on the pad.
pad.engineer: Liftoff thrust-to-weight below 1: the stack never leaves the pad.

short.kid: It would run out of push before the target.
short.engineer: Propellant depleted below the target (or Δv margin below zero at core burnout).

landing.kid: It would not keep fuel to land.
landing.engineer: Landing reserve Δv below the boost-back need at stage-1 burnout speed.

booster-landing.kid: Its boosters would not save fuel to land.
booster-landing.engineer: Booster landing reserve Δv below the boost-back need at booster burnout speed.

fit.kid: The cargo would not fit in the nose cone.
fit.engineer: Payload envelope exceeds the fairing's volume or diameter.
